pages.title: Asset Utilization Intelligence
pages.heroHeadline: Get More Productivity from Every Asset
pages.subtitle: Increase productive asset time, reduce idle capacity, and unlock output without adding fleet.

sections.title: Key Challenge
sections.description: Capacity is constrained. Assets still sit idle.
bullets: Most fleets do not have a utilization problem — they have a visibility problem.
Assets underused while demand grows.
Excess idle or dwell time.
Empty miles eroding margins.
Too much capital tied in underperforming assets.

sections.title: What High Performance Looks Like
bullets: Know which assets are over- or under-utilized.
Know where time is lost between jobs.
Know when assets should be redeployed.
Know how to increase output without adding fleet.

sections.title: How It Works
sections.description: Utilization intelligence built from operational data.
bullets: Correlate trips, idle time, dwell time, assignments, route activity and asset availability.
Turn raw telematics into decisions on: use more, move differently, right-size fleet.

cards.title: Fleet Utilization Benchmarking
cards.text: Compare vehicles, routes, teams or depots. Find underperforming assets, capacity gaps and utilization imbalance. Outcome: improve fleet productivity without adding assets.

cards.title: Idle Reduction
cards.text: Detect excess idle, long dwell times and unproductive route patterns. Outcome: reduce wasted hours and fuel.

cards.title: Asset Redeployment
cards.text: Rebalance fleet allocation, delay capex and support expansion planning. Outcome: more output from existing assets.
